# E0422: a when names a field that is not a condition

A when names a field bare, which tests a field's presence when the field is
optional; a field that is always present is not a condition. Compare it with
something to make one.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
	count: int
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}

ForwardLens: (prev): {
	self: {
		name:  prev.name
		count: _drop(prev.count)
	}
	lacunas: {
		count: [{
			type:    DroppedField
			message: "count is gone"
			when:    prev.name
		}]
	}
}

BackwardLens: (self): {
	prev: {
		name:  self.name
		count: 0
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}
```

thema reports:
